newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields end mixed, crown weakens.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields end mixed, crown weakens.

text.p: Swedish debt yields ended mixed on Tuesday after a rollercoaster session.
Dealers said buyers were entering the market again, seeing good deals, because it had been depressed for some days.
Crown weakness was a concern because it could prevent future cuts to the Riksbank's repurchase rate, dealers said.

The Riksbank left its repo rate at an unchanged fixed 4.10 percent, as expected by the market. * Six month T-bill rate drops four basis points to 4.09 pct * Nine year bond yield remains unchanged at 6.87 pct * Mark stronger at 4.4505 crown vs 4.4345 late Monday
STOCKHOLM, Feb 4 (Reuter) - Longer Swedish bond yields ended flat on Tuesday but the shorter end closed lower after a rollercoaster session.

Some dealers were re-entering the market after several days of weakness, spotting good buys. Dealers said behind the up and down movement were diverging views on the possibility of more cuts in the Riksbank's key interest rates.

"Some believe that there will be further cuts of the repo rate since inflation is non-existant and they are buying. Others do not believe in cuts because of the weakness of the crown so they are selling," one dealer said.

The crown weakened to 4.4505 crowns against the mark, compared to 4.4345 crowns late on Monday. Dealers said political turbulence was behind the crown weakness, although they said the market was calm with small flows.
The Riksbank kept its repo rate unchanged at a fixed rate of 4.10 percent, which was in line with market expectations.
The market is focusing on the U.S. Federal Reserve policy setting FOMC meeting. No rate hike was expected.
The market is also watching the crown, which is believed to determine further cuts in the repo rate.
